---
title: "Shannon Diversity by Site"
output:
  pdf_document: default
  html_notebook: default
---

```{r}
# Load required libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(data.table)
library(stringr)
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(tidyr)
library(rprojroot)
library(vegan)
library(ggpubr)
library(ggbeeswarm)
library(gridExtra) 
library(eoffice)

# CNS journal color scheme
cns_colors <- c("#E64B35", "#4DBBD5", "#00A087", "#3C5488", "#F39B7F", "#8491B4", "#91D1C2", "#DC0000", "#7E6148", "#B09C85")

# Read data file paths
virome_table <- sprintf("%s/data/wastewater_virome_abundance_table1.tsv", find_rstudio_root_file())
metadata_table <- sprintf("%s/data/wastewater_sample_metadata_table1.tsv", find_rstudio_root_file())
population_table <- sprintf("%s/data/wastewater_cachment_area_population.tsv", find_rstudio_root_file())

# Read data
virome_dt <- fread(virome_table, sep = "\t", header = TRUE)
meta_dt <- fread(metadata_table, sep = "\t", header = TRUE)
pop_dt <- fread(population_table, sep = "\t", header = TRUE)

# Data processing
seqname_sID_wide_dt <- virome_dt %>% 
  select(sequence_name, sample_ID, RPKMF) %>%
  distinct(sequence_name, sample_ID, RPKMF) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = sequence_name, values_from = RPKMF, values_fill = 0)

sampleID_l <- seqname_sID_wide_dt$sample_ID
seqname_sID_wide_dt <- seqname_sID_wide_dt %>% select(-sample_ID)

# Calculate Shannon diversity index
shannon_d <- vegan::diversity(seqname_sID_wide_dt, index = "shannon")

# Create a data frame with sample IDs and Shannon diversity indices
sample_diversity <- data.frame(sample_ID = sampleID_l, shannon_d = shannon_d)
# Merge sample diversity data and metadata
sample_diversity_meta <- merge(sample_diversity, meta_dt, by = "sample_ID")

# Filter out sites with less than 2 samples
sample_diversity_meta <- sample_diversity_meta %>%
  group_by(Site) %>%
  filter(n() >= 2) %>%
  ungroup()

# Order sites by median Shannon diversity in descending order
sample_diversity_meta$Site <- reorder(sample_diversity_meta$Site, sample_diversity_meta$shannon_d, FUN = median, decreasing = TRUE)

# Create box plot without p-value display
p <- ggplot(sample_diversity_meta, aes(x = Site, y = shannon_d, fill = Site)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_beeswarm(alpha = 0.6) +
  labs(x = "Sampling Site", y = "Shannon Diversity") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cns_colors) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

# Perform pairwise Wilcoxon tests and calculate adjusted p-values
site_pairs <- combn(unique(sample_diversity_meta$Site), 2, simplify = FALSE)
pairwise_result <- data.frame(
  pairs = sapply(site_pairs, function(pair) paste(pair, collapse = " - ")),
  p.value = sapply(site_pairs, function(pair) {
    group1 <- sample_diversity_meta$shannon_d[sample_diversity_meta$Site == pair[1]]
    group2 <- sample_diversity_meta$shannon_d[sample_diversity_meta$Site == pair[2]]
    wilcox.test(group1, group2)$p.value
  })
)
pairwise_result$p.adjusted <- p.adjust(pairwise_result$p.value, method = "BH")

# Format p-values
pairwise_result$p.value <- ifelse(pairwise_result$p.value < 0.001, 
                                  format(pairwise_result$p.value, scientific = TRUE), 
                                  as.character(round(pairwise_result$p.value, 3)))
pairwise_result$p.adjusted <- ifelse(pairwise_result$p.adjusted < 0.001, 
                                     format(pairwise_result$p.adjusted, scientific = TRUE), 
                                     as.character(round(pairwise_result$p.adjusted, 3)))

# Create table
tab <- ggtexttable(pairwise_result[, c("pairs", "p.value", "p.adjusted")], 
                   rows = NULL, 
                   theme = ttheme("blank", base_size = 10),
                   cols = c("Pairs", "P-value", "Adjusted P-value")) %>%
  tab_add_hline(at.row = 1:2, row.side = "top", linewidth = 1)  %>% 
  tab_add_hline(at.row = nrow(pairwise_result) + 1, row.side = "bottom", linewidth = 1) %>%
  tab_add_title(text = "Pairwise Wilcoxon Test Results", face = "bold", size = 14)

# Save box plot as PDF
ggsave(sprintf("%s/charts/shannon_diversity_boxplot.pdf", find_rstudio_root_file()), p, width = 6, height = 6)

# Save box plot as PPTX
pptx_boxplot_filename <- sprintf("%s/charts/shannon_diversity_boxplot.pptx", find_rstudio_root_file())
topptx(p, filename = pptx_boxplot_filename, height = 4, width = 6)

# Save p-value table as PDF
ggsave(sprintf("%s/charts/shannon_diversity_pvalue_table.pdf", find_rstudio_root_file()), tab, width = 4, height = max(3, nrow(pairwise_result) * 0.3))

# Save p-value table as PPTX
pptx_table_filename <- sprintf("%s/charts/shannon_diversity_pvalue_table.pptx", find_rstudio_root_file())
topptx(tab, filename = pptx_table_filename, height = max(3, nrow(pairwise_result) * 0.3), width = 4)

# Linear analysis between Shannon diversity and log10-transformed population
linear_analysis <- merge(sample_diversity_meta, pop_dt, by = "Site") %>%
  mutate(log10_Population = log10(Population)) %>%
  group_by(City, Site, log10_Population) %>%
  summarize(average_shan = mean(shannon_d)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = log10_Population, y = average_shan, color = City)) +
  geom_point(size = 5, alpha = 0.7) + 
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = F) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = cns_colors) +
  labs(x = "Log10 (Population)", y = "Average Shannon Diversity") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12)
  )

# Save linear analysis plot as PDF
ggsave(sprintf("%s/charts/average_shannon_diversity_by_log10_population.pdf", find_rstudio_root_file()), linear_analysis, width = 6, height = 4)

# Save linear analysis plot as PPTX
pptx_linear_filename <- sprintf("%s/charts/average_shannon_diversity_by_log10_population.pptx", find_rstudio_root_file())
topptx(linear_analysis, filename = pptx_linear_filename, height = 4, width = 6)
```
